event_name: MOPAR NHRA Las Vegas Nationals powered by Dodge

pairs.note:
Weather conditions: air temperature 60 degrees, relative humidity 63 percent, barometer 29.72 inches,
adjusted altitude 3,017 feet, track temperature 79 degrees.

Brown is 22 - 19 against Pruett in prior events. 

Brown with the starting line advantage, but was up in smoke right at the hit and pedaled it a couple
time, but couldn't get it to hook up.

Pruett lost traction right off the starting line, but pedaled it one time and got it to hook up  for
the win.  She is advancing to her 29th final round of her career and fourth of the season.

Langdon is 34 - 22 against Kalitta in prior events. 

Langdon with the starting line advantage, but was up in smoke right at the hit and pedaled it couple
times.

Kalitta launched hard and was straight down the groove for the win.  He will have lane choice over
Pruett in the final.  Kalitta is advancing to his ninth final this season and 135th career final.
